text:
samir (platform): FYI found an edge-case during failover + key rotation when the KMS adapter retries across regions. It can -rarely- grant a temporary token with broader scope than expected. Not just theoretical, saw it in staging this morning.
jen (compliance): ugh. can you repro and attach logs? sounds like an RBAC leak.
samir (platform): repro steps below. short thread so we can triage quickly.
---
samir (platform): repro notes:
1) Create customer key via onboarding flow (import-style).
2) Trigger regional failover while rotation window opens.
3) Adapter retries to second KMS endpoint; our token exchange completes before the per-region policy check reconciles.
4) Token minted has runtime "kms:import, kms:rotate, admin:delete" in the claim (unexpected).

Example log excerpt:```
2026-03-18T09:12:04Z adapter DEBUG request_id=rt-9b12 auth_claims={"sub":"svc-account-abc","scopes":["kms:rotate","kms:import"],"exp":1712345678}
2026-03-18T09:12:04Z adapter WARN reconciliation_delay_ms=412 auth_evaluated_scopes=["kms:rotate"]
2026-03-18T09:12:04Z authproxy ERROR token_issued_overgrant=true requested=["kms:import","kms:rotate"] issued=["kms:import","kms:rotate","admin:delete"]
```
maria (sec-eng): that admin:delete claim is the scary bit. looks like a policy merge bug when the adapter reads both region policies then applies a union instead of intersection.
liam (oncall): are there any active customers affected in prod?
samir (platform): brief scan shows 2 customers had concurrent rotations during a multi-region failover in the last 7 days. no confirmed deletes but we need to assume risk and treat as incident until proven otherwise.
jen (compliance): escalate please. we need an evidence bundle (immutable) and to notify legal/pc as per SOC2 timeline. retention requirements: export related audit logs to locked S3 and enable write-once mode.
---
samir (platform): quick mitigations I applied (already):
- disabled automatic cross-region rotation in adapter (feature flag: adapter.cross_region_rotate=false)
- added circuit-breaker to reject token mint when reconciliation_delay_ms > 200
- revoked issued tokens that match overgrant signature (revocations pushed to introspection service)

maria (sec-eng): good. next: we need a short-term RBAC change to prevent admin:delete being issued even if policy union happens. propose a service role rule that drops any admin-level scope unless a second approval label exists. suggested k8s rolebinding snippet:```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: kms-key-operator-limited
rules:
- apiGroups: ["kms.redwood.dev"]
  resources: ["keys","rotations"]
  verbs: ["get","patch","create"] # NO delete
```
Apply RoleBinding only to adapter service account.
jen (compliance): that aligns with least privilege. Add a policy gate: any delete/import requires a 2-person approval label (annotation) on the key resource and must be logged to immutable audit store.
liam (oncall): how do we force immediate audit immutability? our S3 lifecycle policy is not write-once by default.
samir (platform): short-term: stream audit events to the compliance-archive bucket with Object Lock enabled and Governance mode, retention 7y. We'll create a tarball of the evidence and store it with lock.
jen (compliance): please include attestation artifacts from the HSM vendor for imported keys (attestation statement, nonce, serial). compliance needs that for customer-managed-key onboarding.
maria (sec-eng): noted. we should also add automated detection: a daily job that looks for any key resource with admin-like scopes in token history and files a ticket if found. minimal false positives by excluding known maintenance windows.
---
liam (oncall): incident response checklist items I want echoed here so I can own them: 1) rotate the affected customer keys if at risk (coordinate w/SE) 2) freeze auto-rotation 3) notify customers with P1 template 4) open SE task to validate there were no destructive ops 5) create post-incident runbook item for adapter reconciliation logic.
jen (compliance): add timeline: initial detection within 24h -> legal notified within 48h -> customers notified within 72h if confirmed. preserve chain-of-custody.
maria (sec-eng): vuln triage notes: probable cause = policy-merge union bug in adapter cache layer when multiple region policy manifests are present. Priority: P0 for production risk; P2 if only staging. We need a test that simulates concurrent rotation+failover at the infra e2e level.
samir (platform): action items (assign):
- samir: push hotfix to adapter that intersects policies instead of union + add unit tests (ETA: 6h)
- maria: create detection job + temp IAM role to drop delete scope (ETA: 4h)
- liam: start incident ticket, coordinate customer comms + rotate keys if instructed (ETA: now)
- jen: prep evidence storage procedures and legal notification template (ETA: 6h)

maria (sec-eng): one more: require HSM import attestation handshake for all imported keys going forward. i.e. import flow must include vendor_attestation=jws and operator_nonce=uuid verified by attestation service before key becomes active.
jen (compliance): agree. also require KMS integrations to log the HSM device serial in each rotation event for audit.
---
deploy-bot: deployment started for adapter hotfix #4623 -> staging
deploy-bot: deployment succeeded in staging (build:b9f3c) :rocket:

samir (platform): pushing PR to disable cross-region rotate by default with explicit opt-in. link: https://git.redwood/infr/adapter/pull/4624
liam (oncall): I'll run emergency e2e that simulates region failover + rotation in staging and report back.
jen (compliance): please tag legal once evidence bundle is ready (jen, legal@redwood).
maria (sec-eng): I'll draft a short postmortem template focusing on RBAC and reconciliation bugs. we will run a tabletop on Friday with infra, platform, and compliance.
samir (platform): thanks all. I'll update thread with results of staging e2e within 3h. :thumbsup:
